newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: SOCCER-PORTO V MANCHESTER UNITED TEAMS.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-PORTO V MANCHESTER UNITED TEAMS.

text.p: Teams for Wednesday's European Cup quarter-final second leg match between Portugal's Porto and Manchester United of England:

Porto: 1-Andrezej Wosniak; 2-Joao Pinto, 19-Joao Manuel Pinto, 22-Jorge Costa, 3-Rui Jorge, 20-Paulinho Santos, 17-Jose Barroso, 5-Fernando Mendes, 21-Edmilson Pimenta, 11-Ljubimko Drulovic, 16-Mario Jardel.

Manchester United: 1-Peter Schmeichel; 2-Gary Neville, 4-David May, 6-Gary Pallister, 3-Denis Irwin, 5-Ronny Johnsen, 10-David Beckham, 16-Roy Keane, 8-Nicky Butt, 7-Eric Cantona, 20-Ole Gunnar Solskjaer.
